audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers claimed you out-range Veigar's Q. whys[0] says 'You outrange his Q' and content early says 'you outrange his Baleful Strike (Q)'. Baleful Strike is 1000 range; Command: Attack is 815.
audit.why: It reverses the spacing rule a player needs. He pokes you from outside your ball, so the early edge is your autos and his missing cage, not range.
audit.corrected: whys[0], early, breakdown.early and phases[1].why now state the 1000-vs-815 gap and re-ground the level 1 edge on him having no cage until 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 doubles your lane presence' and 'Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar' — the second is a magnitude with no source, and the real shape of this lane is a 4-6 window that closes on his first item.
audit.why: Primordial Burst grows with your missing health, so a healthy Orianna is safe at 6; his first item plus a full cage-into-Dark-Matter combo is what closes the window.
audit.corrected: Spike line rewritten to mana at Lost Chapter, levels 4-6 as your window, his first item evening it.
sources: brief enemyKit R text 'increasing based on the target's missing health'

audit.whatIsWrong: The page had the Event Horizon edge-stun mechanic right but never attached a number to it, and breakdown.cooldowns held no digit at all. dosFull[2].d also called the window 'fifteen-second'.
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 and 14s at max — the longest cooldown either champion has in lane, and the entire green light for stepping up.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dosFull[2].d now carry Event Horizon 20s/725 range, Primordial Burst 120s/650 range, and the twenty-second window.
sources: brief enemyKit E cd 20/18.5/17/15.5/14, range 725, text 'Stuns enemies that pass through'

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6' in a Veigar matchup.
audit.why: Template leak, and the timing is wrong for Veigar anyway — his kill combo needs a first item behind it.
audit.corrected: Retargeted to his cage combo by two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1..4].side disagreed with content win[1..4] (Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Skill against Skill/Skill/Orianna/Orianna).
audit.why: content win[] matches the packet levelChart and the whys prose; the phases layer carried its own verdict.
audit.corrected: Those four sides moved to the win[] values with their whys rewritten in one atomic group. Rows 0 and 5 already agreed. Row 6 was deliberately left alone — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said why letting him farm freely is itself the loss condition.
audit.why: Phenomenal Evil Power grants permanent AP for striking a champion with a spell or scoring a takedown, and Baleful Strike kills add more — the scaling has no cap.
audit.corrected: breakdown.feeding and ahead now frame the lane as starving stacks rather than winning trades.
sources: brief enemyKit Q text 'Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently'

notes: ROW 6 LEFT ALONE ON PURPOSE. phases[6].side says Veigar and content win[6] says Orianna, and I could not decide which is right from the kit, so I changed neither. The packet itself flags the chart: 'Orianna wins only 46.17% but the chart gives Orianna 4/7 stages vs 0'. The kit supports the Veigar reading late — Phenomenal Evil Power is uncapped permanent AP and Dark Matter's cooldown shrinks with stacks — but the whole content layer (win[6], whys[6], spikes[3].text, late) argues the Orianna reading from teamfight value, and flipping win[6] would mean rewriting four content fields against the packet levelChart. This is a pre-existing disagreement, not one I introduced. Question recorded for the user. Rows 1-4 were fixed: phases[1..4].side contradicted content win[1..4], win[] matched the packet levelChart and the whys, so those four sides were moved and their whys rewritten as one atomic group. Ratings untouched. Factual correction: two fields claimed you out-range Baleful Strike — it is 1000 range against your 815, so the claim was backwards; both fixed and the level-1 edge re-grounded on him having no cage until 3. Left templated but not grounded: report[6].t, report[7].t and report[12].t are Orianna-generic but contain nothing false.
